concept: Modeling a service-oriented mindset for children or younger people watching how you live
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic family or mentoring scenario where a younger person is absorbing the adult's real behavior around helping others, not just their stated values
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does your actual behavior around service teach, regardless of what you say?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one visible way to involve a younger person in an act of service together

assessment.success_marker: adult names a specific, shared activity, not just a value they hope to pass on abstractly
